permissions.unavailable: Permission rules are not available in this build.
permissions.autoReadsHint: Commands such as ls, cat, grep, find, git status, git log and git diff are approved without asking when they only read files inside the project. A command that reads outside the project, writes a file, runs another program or uses the network still asks. Rules you saved keep working whether this is on or off.
permissions.rulesHint: OXESpace answers the agent's approval prompts with these rules. Allow rules approve only when every command in a line, or every file, is covered; deny rules decline. Anything else still asks you. A denied MCP tool is also removed from the agent's tools when its next session starts.
permissions.noneHint: Use “Always allow” on an approval, or add one below.
permissions.noDecisionsHint: Approvals, rule changes, undo and rewind appear here for 180 days.

config.restartModels: Restart the updated app to load models.
config.label: Conversation configuration
config.modeTitle: Plan: the agent plans first and changes nothing until you approve. Agent: it works on the task.
config.readOnlyClaude: Read, search and answer questions. Shell, agents and MCP tools are disabled.
config.readOnlyCodex: Explore the project without writing files.
config.nativeHint: Use tools and MCP with Claude’s saved rules and approval requests.
config.workspaceHint: Allow edits inside this project. External paths still require approval.
config.fullHint: Run tools with expanded access under your operating system account.
config.neverHint: Reject approval prompts instead of asking.
config.hooksOn: Hooks from the active Claude configuration can run.
config.autoAcceptHint: File edits in this project are applied without asking. Commands and other tools still ask.
config.codexHint: Access and approvals are separate. MCP servers may still ask, even with Never ask.
config.expandBody: Tools can modify files and run processes beyond this project. Native permission prompts may be bypassed; operating system restrictions still apply.
config.nativeBody: Claude will use its native tool and MCP permissions, including saved rules. Requests that require a decision will appear in this conversation. This mode does not provide a project filesystem sandbox.
config.workspaceBody: The agent can modify files in this project. Access outside the workspace remains subject to native approvals.
config.appliesHere: Applies to this conversation. An active turn keeps its current configuration.
config.networkBody: Workspace commands in this conversation will be able to reach the network.
config.neverBody: Actions that require approval will be rejected automatically instead of asking you. MCP servers may still ask.
config.hooksBody: Hooks from the active Claude configuration can run commands before or after tool calls in this conversation.
config.nextTurnTitle: The current turn keeps its configuration. Your selection applies to the next message.

events.unavailable: The event inspector is not available in this build.
events.scanLimited: Only the most recent events were searched.
events.none: This conversation has no saved events yet.
events.truncated: The event is longer than the inspector shows; the rest is cut.
